enchantments.tooltip: +4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Shrieking: Shrieking weapons emit a piercing screech whenever they are used to make a successful attack. This screech deals an additional 2 to 12 sonic damage.
Roaring: This weapon causes targets to become shaken (DC 25 Will save negates) and, on a critical hit, does 2 to 12 sonic damage to the target.
